title: The Glue Guy: How Josh Hart Found His Calling in New York
description:
Josh Hart's journey from forgotten trade piece to championship glue guy is the untold story of the Knicks' 2026 title run. Acquired from Portland on February 8, 2023, for Cam Reddish and a protected pick, Hart became the Ironman who averaged 42+ minutes per game in the playoffs—the first Knick since 2004 to do so. He grabbed 15 rebounds while scoring just 3 points in Finals Game 1. He played 39 minutes in the championship clincher. He reunited with Villanova teammate Jalen Brunson and helped import a culture of sacrifice and winning.

This is the blueprint for the modern role player: defend multiple positions, rebound like a big man, screen relentlessly, and never need the ball. Hart's four-year, $81 million contract looks like highway robbery. His legacy is secure. He's the glue that held a championship together.
